reason: The cited evidence (E1) directly supports that adding 2% nano-CeO2 refines grain structure and that the baseline coating has uneven hard phase distribution, but it does not provide evidence for the mechanistic links to reduced stress concentrations, crack initiation, or friction variability, which are inferred rather than demonstrated.
premises: Nano-CeO2 addition refines grain structure in FeCoNiCrMo0.2 HEA coatings
Refined grain structure leads to more uniform distribution of hard phases
Uniform hard phase distribution reduces localized stress concentrations and crack initiation
Reduced stress concentrations lower friction variability and wear rate
Baseline HEA+WC coatings have uneven hard phase distribution causing unstable hardness and wear resistance
